# Copy Markdown Content Checklist: Copy Markdown Content

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for the tab-menu copy action, clipboard contract, configurable shortcut, validation and persistence.
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Focus**: Copy action/menu/clipboard behaviour and shortcut configuration/persistence
**Depth**: Standard
**Audience**: Reviewer (PR)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the exact boundary of "entire raw Markdown source" defined, including frontmatter, trailing newlines and encoding? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are requirements defined for the tab menu item's enabled/disabled state and label when no document is active? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the clipboard write contract complete for both the menu action and the shortcut, including the plain-text-only assumption? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are success and failure confirmation requirements complete, including message content, tone and duration? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for the settings control's full lifecycle: open, view, record, save, cancel, reject and restore default? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for how the shortcut hint is rendered in the menu on every supported platform? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-006, SC-003]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "brief confirmation" quantified with a specific duration or dismissal behaviour? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the menu hint format specified precisely (brackets, spacing, modifier names and key capitalization)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the shortcut syntax defined unambiguously, including allowed keys, required modifiers and whether multi-key chords are permitted? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "active document" defined for the shortcut when several tabs are open or one is being focused? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the source of an inactive tab's copy defined as the viewer's loaded content rather than a fresh disk read? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "does not freeze the interface" quantified with a measurable threshold for large documents? [Measurability, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the validation message required to name the invalid value and the conflicting action? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the location and presentation of the shortcut settings control specified clearly enough to be reviewed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Dependencies]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 - Do the menu action and shortcut requirements guarantee the same copied content and confirmation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are frontmatter and whole-document requirements consistent between the acceptance scenarios and FR-003? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Acceptance §2]
- [ ] CHK017 - Do the menu hint and the effective shortcut stay consistent after remapping, restart and default restoration? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-012, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are the fixed-shortcut exclusion requirements consistent with feature 005's `Ctrl`/`Cmd`+`D` and the existing tab/log/find shortcuts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-016, Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is the modal-suppression set consistent with every modal that can be open, including the bookmark picker introduced by 005? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Dependencies]

## Shortcut Configuration & Persistence

- [ ] CHK020 - Are the platform-specific default shortcuts defined for every supported platform, including the modifier name shown to the reader? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is the `shortcuts.toml` location defined for Linux, macOS and Windows? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is the precedence between a missing file, malformed TOML, unknown keys and an invalid shortcut entry specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are recovery requirements defined after an invalid saved shortcut, including whether the previous value or the default is restored? [Recovery, Spec §FR-015, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for writing the settings file, including atomicity, concurrent edits and write failure? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is "restore the default" defined to include persistence, immediate effect and the menu hint update? [Completeness, Acceptance §3, Spec §FR-011, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the shortcut equality rule defined for case, modifier order and left/right modifier variants? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are conflict requirements limited to app shortcuts, or do they also cover operating-system and other-application shortcuts? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-016]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 - Are requirements defined for copying a document that was removed from disk after it was opened? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are requirements defined separately for clipboard unavailability and clipboard permission denial? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are requirements defined for copying while a background reload or watcher write is in flight? [Coverage, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are requirements defined for zero-state, one-document and many-tab cases for the menu and shortcut? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are keyboard-repeat, focus-loss and modal-open-during-keypress scenarios addressed? [Coverage, Gap, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are requirements defined for a document with unusual content (empty file, CRLF, BOM, very large file)? [Coverage, Gap, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are rollback/recovery requirements defined when the settings file cannot be written after a valid change? [Recovery, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK035 - Is the confirmation latency requirement measurable and scoped to a representative document size? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK036 - Is the read-only requirement stated for all copy paths and all document states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK037 - Are accessibility requirements defined for the menu item, shortcut hint, settings control and validation feedback? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK038 - Are privacy or clipboard-retention requirements defined for copied source, especially for sensitive documents? [Non-Functional, Gap]
- [ ] CHK039 - Are platform differences beyond modifier naming addressed, such as keyboard layouts, international keys and native menu conventions? [Coverage, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK040 - Is the dependency on 005's shared shortcut registry documented as a hard constraint rather than an optional implementation choice? [Dependency, Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK041 - Is the dependency on 005's generic tab-menu item helper and modal-open predicate documented? [Dependency, Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK042 - Is the assumption that the viewer's loaded content is the source of truth validated against reload and rename behaviour? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK043 - Is the assumption that no new capability permission is required documented and reviewed? [Assumption, Gap]
- [ ] CHK044 - Are the plan and tasks for this feature explicitly deferred until after 005, with a stated reason? [Dependency, Dependencies]

## Ambiguities, Conflicts & Traceability

- [ ] CHK045 - Does the spec define whether the shortcut fires inside contenteditable regions, selects and rich-text controls, not just inputs and textareas? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK046 - Is the interaction between the shortcut and the document find bar's own keyboard handling specified? [Consistency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK047 - Is the menu item's position relative to Copy path/Copy file and Bookmark document specified, or intentionally left free? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK048 - Is the behaviour defined when two copies are requested in quick succession? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK049 - Are requirement IDs and acceptance criteria traceable from every user story through FRs and SCs, with no orphan requirements? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001–FR-016, §SC-001–SC-009]
- [ ] CHK050 - Is the conflict between "only the copy shortcut is remappable" and future shortcut features explicitly bounded? [Conflict, Spec §FR-013, Dependencies]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
